delete.group: After deleting "{{name}}", every scheduled task bound to this group stops sending notifications, while the tasks themselves keep reporting success. Make sure those tasks have been pointed at another group.
delete.user: After removing "{{name}}", alerts no longer @-mention them. Messages already sent are unaffected.

dialog.addGroupDesc: Send a test immediately after adding — saving only means the URL was stored.
dialog.addUserDesc: Used to @-mention specific people in alert messages.

empty.groupReason: Inspection and alert results have nowhere to go. Scheduled tasks will run and report success, but the results reach nobody.
empty.reason: Alerts still reach the group; nobody is @-mentioned. That is fine for a small team.
empty.title: No people configured

error.groups: Lark groups could not be loaded
error.title: The list could not be loaded

fallbackOnly.body: Inspection results go to the fallback webhook configured under Basic Settings → System. Note that the fallback is neither visible nor testable from this page — verify it there. A group bound to a specific task takes precedence over the fallback.
fallbackOnly.title: No Lark group here, but a global fallback endpoint is in use

field.groupNameHint: A name for humans, such as "Ops alerts".
field.openIdHint: From the Lark admin console or API, starting with ou_. A wrong value raises no error — the mention simply does not reach anyone.
field.webhookHint: The Lark group bot webhook. ⚠️ It is a credential in itself: anyone holding it can post to that group, so keep it out of tickets and chat logs.

hint: Who receives inspection and alert results. When this is empty, tasks still run and still report success — nobody just receives anything.

noGroup.body: Inspection results such as a filling disk or an expiring certificate cannot be delivered, while the scheduled tasks themselves still report success and raise no error. This is a silent failure: you find out when it matters.
noGroup.title: No Lark group configured

section.groupsHint: Where alerts are delivered. Always send a test after adding one.
section.usersHint: Who gets @-mentioned. Optional — messages still go out without it.

test.failed: The test message could not be delivered
test.sent: Sent — check the group to confirm it actually arrived. A success response only means Lark accepted the request.

title: Notification targets
